page.layout: One block of text, centred, with a decorative woodcut ornament printed below it. The gathering signature stands below the text on the right.

main_text.l: in epistola hac fua sic praedicarit, ut vix reperias
ab Apostolo isto aliam quamvis Ecclesiam, ad
quam unquam scripserit, sic a fide, spe, charita-
te, sanctisque officiis omnibus laudatam, ut i-
ant igitur hominum merita, ut soli gratiae
Dei in Christo Jesu sit omnis laus

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a diamond-shaped arabesque) is not text and is not transcribed. The text is centred with no indents, so it is set as one paragraph. Long s is written as plain s. The printed hyphens in "charita-te", "i-stam", "Dispere-ant" and "seculo-rum" are kept. The signature mark "Q ij" stands in the right margin area below the text rather than at the very foot of the page; I read it as "Q ij" with some uncertainty about the Q symbol. The catchword is absent.
